faq.a: No public one. Paste a SalvageBid search link and get every vehicle with VIN specs, damage, title, odometer, current bid and retail value.

faq.q: Can I use it as a SalvageBid API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: SalvageBid has no public API. This actor reads its public search results, with the vehicle's VIN details, damage and current bid.
